/** Only advances the scalar frame metadata generated by prepare_art.py. */
class org.flashNight.arki.scene.Cf6VehicleTimeline {
    public static function pose(clip:MovieClip,frame:Number):Boolean {
        if(typeof clip!="movieclip" || !(frame>=1) || frame>clip._totalframes) return false;
        if(clip._currentframe!==frame) clip.gotoAndStop(frame);
        return true;
    }
    public static function advance(clip:MovieClip,holdRoot:Boolean):Void {
        if(typeof clip!="movieclip" || typeof clip.__cf6SourceId!="number") return;
        if(!holdRoot) {
            var next:Number=clip.__cf6Next;
            if(next>=1 && next<=clip._totalframes && next!==clip._currentframe) clip.gotoAndStop(next);
        }
        var parentPose:String;
        for(var name:String in clip) {
            var child:MovieClip=clip[name];
            if(typeof child!="movieclip" || child._parent!==clip || typeof child.__cf6SourceId!="number") continue;
            advance(child,false);
            if(typeof child.__cf6ParentPose=="string") parentPose=child.__cf6ParentPose;
            if(child.__cf6RemoveParent===true) clip.__cf6RetireVisual=true;
        }
        if(parentPose!==undefined) clip.gotoAndStop(parentPose);
    }
}
